spec.outfit: an 1890s Victorian lady's walking dress in the same style and fabrics as a gentleman's brown tweed jacket, red waistcoat, cream breeches and brown bowler -- a small brown felt hat like a lady's bowler with a narrow curled brim, a dark red ribbon band and one small brown feather; a one-piece day dress in brown tweed: a fitted bodice with a dark red waistcoat-style front panel buttoned with a row of small brass buttons, narrow brown tweed lapels either side of it, a white high stand collar with a small black ribbon bow at the throat, long fitted sleeves with modest puffed shoulders and white cuffs; a smooth A-line brown tweed skirt to mid-calf, hanging straight with a single cream band near the hem, no bustle, no flounces, no ruffles, no drapery; black stockings; black leather lace-up ankle boots with a low heel; short black leather gloves
spec.style: Photorealistic 3D character render, soft studio lighting, real fabric textures, clean simple tailoring, every garment complete and well fitted to the goose's body. Smart and tailored but simple: dressier than sportswear, far plainer than a ball gown. The goose keeps its own head exactly: black head and neck, white cheek patch, eyes and beak unchanged. The goose has NO tail.
